name: The partner waits at doors, rides lifts and leads over slabs
body: games/platformer: a NavigationDynamics system registers the level's gates, moving platforms and crumbling slabs with the graph after the partner builds it, and feeds each one's state in every step. The partner replans when a feature changes, waits in front of a shut door (counting as waiting, not stuck), boards a platform when it is level with the landing, rides it and steps off at the far landing, and takes fragile slabs only as the leader (never while following, never when they would strand her). Room tests for hold the door, flow and fragile, the station and the crossing keep passing, with new assertions that the path is the one in use.
